content.title: Home page catalog CTA routes visitors to the published books catalog
content.test_md_blob:
# Home page catalog CTA routes visitors to the published books catalog

> Prove that the home-page CTA for browsing all published books takes the visitor to `/books`.

## Step 1

Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-47

On the Fernwood Press home page, activate `Browse all published books →`, then assert the browser URL path equals `/books`.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: absolute
      operand: /books
      operator: equals
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-47
    objective: On the Fernwood Press home page, activate `Browse all published books →`, then assert the browser URL path equals `/books`.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-47
scenario: Use the catalog CTA on the home page to reach the published books catalog
title: Home page catalog CTA routes visitors to the published books catalog
